body: with some days daily usage, I can not reproduce such crash , even in neovim. I'm afraid that I can't spend more time to try to reproduce this.

The screen/compositor code has been changed since this was opened. As there been no report of reproduction since then, let's assume this particular one has been fixes (we already have other issues for other redraw crashes).

issue.title: compositor: handle invalid screen positions after resize gracefully

repository.name: neovim
repository.description: Vim-fork focused on extensibility and usability

issue.body:
The screen resize logic needs to be refactored to be simpler and more deterministic. Until then, we need to handle attempts to draw outside of the screen size gracefully, just like the old vim code did.

fixes #9989
